description: This file defines the ModerationStateWidget class, a Drupal plugin for rendering a moderation state selection widget in content moderation workflows. It extends OptionsSelectWidget and manages form elements for moderation states, including loading revisions and handling transitions.

classes.name: ModerationStateWidget
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for rendering and managing a moderation state selection widget within content moderation workflows.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes services and dependencies for the widget.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Generates the form for the moderation state widget, returning an empty array if the entity is not moderated.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Builds the form element for selecting a moderation state, loading the current and original states, and determining valid transitions.

methods.name: validateElement
methods.description: Validates the form element, setting the selected transition state.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the widget is applicable for a given field definition, specifically for ModerationStateFieldItemList.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies related to the moderation workflow.
